text:
maria.pm: Quick sync — I sketched a release-slice for private deployments we should prioritise for Q3. Key goals: minimal downtime upgrades, first-class customer-managed networking, and a lightweight airgap installer.
raj.eng: love it. can you break down upgrade options? in-place vs operator vs image-swap?
priya.field: customers keep asking about overlapping CIDRs and NAT+hairpin issues. need a clear fallback.
tom.se: +1 on NAT. Also need CLI flags for tenant IP reservation and outbound-proxy config.
maria.pm: proposal: 3 upgrade patterns - (A) operator-managed rolling (small clusters), (B) image-swap blue-green (larger installs), (C) offline delta patch for airgapped.
raj.eng: tech constraints: our KV cache schema changes make true in-place harder without a compatibility shim. operator-managed can surface metrics for rollback.
priya.field: for customers behind strict IP regimes, we should support a "static-egress" mode where we bind egress to reserved IPs and document port requirements.
maria.pm: note on packaging: split installer into core-runtime + optional-network-hook. core-runtime ~200MB delta for patch updates; network-hook handles ipam and route templates.
raj.eng: will require new manifest field: "network.binding: reserved-cidr | nat | proxy" — teams ok with that?
tom.se: yes. sample flag for installer:
```
./installer --manifest=man.yaml --upgrade-mode=operator --network.binding=reserved-cidr --egress-ip=203.0.113.5
```
priya.field: Customers will need docs for router rules. I'll draft a 1-pager showing iptables snippets and cloud peering examples.
maria.pm: launch criteria draft:
- upgrade path A or B validated with <1% error rate on regression tests
- airgap delta apply tested on 2 customer snapshots
- network modes working with overlapping CIDRs (demo env)
- playbook for rollback <30m
raj.eng: Q: how many engineering sprints? estimate 3 sprints for operator + 2 for image-swap + 2 for airgap tooling.
maria.pm: prioritisation: sprint order = operator, network binding, image-swap, airgap delta. field docs parallelized.
tom.se: can we squeeze a canary script to auto-validate egress ips post-upgrade? I can prototype.
priya.field: assign me to the network playbook and customer validation runway.
maria.pm: owners: raj.eng (operator + manifest), tom.se (canary & image-swap), priya.field (field validation + docs). I'll own release criteria and runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment reminder: weekly infra sync Thursday 10:00 — add release-slice agenda.
maria.pm: action items:
- raj: design manifest PR by EOW
- tom: canary prototype by next Wed
- priya: draft network playbook + sample iptables
- maria: final launch criteria doc and checklist

maria.pm: ok — ping me on blockers. :rocket:
